I'll start. There are many crazy experiences that I have had over the years of my drug exploration. For me the most "crazy" time I have had on drugs was my first real psychedelic experience. Prior to this I had only drank, smoked, and tried two small doses of mushrooms. This time we had "acid". Upon ingesting the substance, I knew immediately that it wasn't the substance advertised. I knew this because the two blotters had a bitter, metallic taste, and I then held the hits in my mouth.

Anyway, I continued to wait for the come up, which started a little sooner than I anticipated I must admit. Around 45 minutes I felt a distinct change in the feeling of my body, it seemed to gain a certain extra weight, and walking became difficult. My friend began to explain that he was starting to trip hard. As we smoked a bowl of cannabis I got intensely more high. I began to see the edges of trees as holographic grouping of colors in beautiful patters. Things were quite wavey, and holographic looking objects were appearing in my vision. I never knew any of this was possible, so it was all quite earth shattering. At one point I actually saw a spiral fractal, like the ones generated by computers, that was colored green and purple. It was a cool experience that had several moments of seeming unbearable intensity. That was likely I got around 2mg for my first trip. It was hard but definitely worth it. I've been exploring ever since then.
Story Time: What is the craziest experience you've had on drugs?

For me, It was my first time tripping on NBOMes Me and a mate were chilling on a school near ours roves he says lets sesh on the shadecloths, which are like a nylon trampoliney sort of thing that gives the students shade. He jumps from a roof in a cannonball on to them, lo and behold they snap instantly. He landed on the concrete bellow on his tailbone and didnt talk for minutes, im tripping my nut and freaking out it looks to me like theres blood all around him (later found to be water and leaves). He eventually says "P....payyyyyy.........paaaaaiiiiiiiinn" Im relived he is alive obviously, though it took us about 30 minuted how to figure out how to get him out of the sealed quadrangle he found himself in. Amazingly he has felt no lasting effects and plays a lot of sport without any back pain.

The experience remains the scariest moment in my life.

TL;DR Dont go on roves tripping balls.

Well I don't quite remember a lot of the night. So I'll share what I do remember and the aftermath found the next morning.

Over the course of a few hours I consumed 2 1/2 ambien, 6 tramidol, and 4 6.7% beers along with a decent amount of pot.

My buddy who had given me the pills stuck around for a bit to make sure I didn't do anything dumb. But after awhile determined I was good for the night. Man, was he wrong. So he took off and left me to my own devices. I was playing games for awhile an everything was okay. But then I ran out of cigarettes. I ended up tearing my room apart to gather enough change to buy a pack. Some how scattering random shit all over the place. But I ended up finding the $7 to get a pack an set out on my journey.

Along the way a furry little critter crossed my path, and I thought it was a cat. So I knelt down and tried to coax it out to pet it. It got curious and slowly crept out of the bush and came closer. It was close enough to pet when I realized it wasn't a cat, but a fuckig raccoon. At that point I must have made a noise of surprise. Because I startled both of us and it went running off.

So I continue to the store with no other incidents. But by the time I got there the pills were hitting me pretty good. I got in and was able to mumble out what brand of smokes I wanted. But at this time was completely unable to count the change I had. So I just kind of plopped it down and ha the clerk count it.

Returning on my way back. I saw a cop car creep by, which kind of freaked me out, but I continued on. A few blocks later another cop, or the same one crept by and really started to freak me out. So I did the only logical thing and jumped into a bush. I posted up for a bit and observed. Saw another cop cruise past and decided to give it a bit longer. In the mean time I came to the conclusion that this spot would be great for a gorilla pot grow. So I grabbed a stick and started tilling the soil, planing on returning with a bunch of seeds I had saved up. Eventually I got bored an forgot about the cops and continued on my journey.

Almost home I walked by a little nature trail that I had always wanted to check out. So I decided this was the perfect opportunity. I tried walking in, but it was far too dark and I didn't want to wander off the trail and fall down a ravine. So I turned back to head home. Almost out of the park I notice a sign forbidding various things. So obviously I fgured it was a great idea to attempt to steal it. I wiggled it around and ended up grabbin my knife to take care of the screws. Ended up cutting my hand and gave up on the sign.

So I walk the last few blocks home. When I arrive I was high as shit and I guess sweating. Because I found clothes scattered around th house. My pants were in the shower, my shirt was hung on my room mates door nob, my robe was in the kitchen, my coat was tossed on the floor and my shoes and socks were on the stove.

All logic has been tossed out the window at this point and most of this comes from surveying the after math the next morning. There was also peanut butter in the microwave and something bizarre was in the freezer.

I had at some point battled with the pack of cigarettes and they were scattered across my bed room floor. I had created some sort of blanket fort, I'm assuming with the intention of hot boxing it. There was pennies and cards scattered everywhere and just general nonsense. I also apparently typed out a rambling page titled "rules to live by".

I was woken up the next morning by my very concerned room mate. They couldn't find me at first, because I for some reason had pushed my bed aside and climbed down in the gap between the bed and the wall.

So yeah, I calmed down on the pills for awhile after that.
What a crazy experience, seemed difficult, but enlightening!
